title: Synthesis and evaluation of novel thiazole moiety-containing compounds as antibreast cancer agents.
authors: Abdelhamid, Moustafa Salaheldin; El-Farargy, Ahmed Fouad; Abdelhai Esawi, Omnia
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并评估含噻唑化合物作为抗乳腺癌药物，涉及孕激素受体分子对接，但核心是药物化学与肿瘤实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Progesterone receptor (PR) agonists represent pivotal agents in trapping breast cancer cells through modulating the expression of estrogen receptor (ER). The present investigation aimed to test three novel thiadiazole-containing compounds as antibreast cancer agents. Test compounds were synthesized and abbreviated as 2-(5-amino-1, 3, 4-thiazole-2-yl) amino-4-(4-chloro-3-methylphenyl)-4-oxobutanoic acid (TAB), 4-(4-chloro-3-methylphenyl)-4-oxo 2-[(5-sulfanyl-1, 3, 4-thiadiazol-2-yl)] sulfanyl-butanoic acid (TSB) and 4-(4-chloro-3-methylphenyl)-4-oxo 2-[(5-sulfanyl-1, 3, 4-thiadiazol-2-yl)] sulphonyl-botanic acid (TSSB). Molecular docking of the test compounds with PR was simulated. The IC 50 of the test compounds against both Michigan cancer foundation-7 (MCF-7) and HepG2 was determined. Ehrlich solid tumor (EST) was grown in the right thigh of the mouse as a model of breast cancer in vivo . Hepatic and renal functions, besides hematological indicators, were tested. The expression of ER and ER genes in EST was determined using real-time PCR. Immunohistochemistry was carried out for the determination of Ki-67 and cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK-1) in EST. Our results revealed that TAB, TSB and TSSB reduced Ehrlich tumor size by 48, 64 and 52%, respectively, compared to the EST control group. The docking scores achieved by TAB, TSB and TSSB with PR were -9.29, -9.41 and -9.24 kcal/mol, respectively. The most potent compound against MCF-7 was TSB, with an IC 50 of 3.9 g/ml. The administration of test compounds suppressed Ki-67 and CDK1, and the best effect was observed at TSB. Our findings suggest that test compounds are applicants to be antibreast cancer agents.
abstract_zh: 孕激素受体（progesterone receptor, PR）激动剂通过调节雌激素受体（estrogen receptor, ER）的表达，在捕获乳腺癌细胞中发挥关键作用。本研究旨在测试三种新型含噻二唑化合物作为抗乳腺癌药物。测试化合物被合成并缩写为2-(5-氨基-1,3,4-噻唑-2-基)氨基-4-(4-氯-3-甲基苯基)-4-氧代丁酸（TAB）、4-(4-氯-3-甲基苯基)-4-氧代-2-[(5-巯基-1,3,4-噻二唑-2-基)]硫代丁酸（TSB）和4-(4-氯-3-甲基苯基)-4-氧代-2-[(5-巯基-1,3,4-噻二唑-2-基)]磺酰基丁酸（TSSB）。模拟了测试化合物与PR的分子对接。测定了测试化合物对密歇根癌症基金会-7（MCF-7）和HepG2的IC 50。在小鼠右腿中生长艾氏实体瘤（Ehrlich solid tumor, EST）作为体内乳腺癌模型。测试了肝肾功能及血液学指标。使用实时PCR测定EST中ER和ER基因的表达。进行免疫组织化学以测定EST中的Ki-67和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶1（cyclin-dependent kinase 1, CDK-1）。我们的结果显示，与EST对照组相比，TAB、TSB和TSSB分别将艾氏肿瘤大小减少了48%、64%和52%。TAB、TSB和TSSB与PR的对接得分分别为-9.29、-9.41和-9.24 kcal/mol。对MCF-7最有效的化合物是TSB，其IC 50为3.9 g/ml。测试化合物的给药抑制了Ki-67和CDK1，且TSB效果最佳。我们的发现表明，测试化合物有望成为抗乳腺癌药物。
